= Source Highlighting with CodeRay
:source-highlighter: coderay
:coderay-css: class

Listings in the languages CodeRay scans, with the options Asciidoctor passes
to it.

== Ruby with line numbers and highlighted lines

[source,ruby,linenums,highlight=2..3]
----
module Greeter
  # Greets someone by name.
  def self.greet(name, punctuation: '!')
    message = "Hello, #{name}#{punctuation}"
    puts message.upcase if name =~ /^[A-Z]/
    @count = (@count || 0) + 1
    $stdout.flush
    :done
  end
end

data = <<~EOS
  heredoc #{1 + 1}
EOS
%w(a b).each_with_index {|w, i| p [w, i, 0x1f, 1.5e3, ?c] }
----

== Java

[source,java]
----
package org.example;

import java.util.List;

/** A greeting. */
public class Main {
  private static final int LIMIT = 0x1F;

  @Override
  public String toString() {
    return "Main" + LIMIT + 'c';
  }

  public static void main(String[] args) {
    List<String> names = List.of("a", "b");
    for (String n : names) { System.out.println(n); } // done
  }
}
----

== Other languages

[source,python]
----
@decorator
class A(B):
    """Docstring."""
    def f(self, x):
        return [i ** 2 for i in range(x)]  # squares

import "fmt"
